description: A one-to-one: updates, challenges, feedback, growth and agreed follow-ups.

sections.heading: Updates
sections.guidance: Progress, wins and news each person shared.

sections.heading: Challenges
sections.guidance: Problems, blockers or worries raised, and any support offered.

sections.heading: Feedback
sections.guidance: Feedback given in either direction, stated plainly, with who gave it to whom.

sections.heading: Growth
sections.guidance: Goals, career and development topics discussed.

sections.heading: Action items
sections.guidance: What each person agreed to do, as Owner: what, by when.
